decision.title: Clear Thinking: Turning Ordinary Moments into Extraordinary Results
decision.author: Shane Parrish

rationale: The official Farnam Street book page, Google Books authorized listing, and Better World Books metadata all align on title, subtitle, author, and a stable 2023 English edition family.
The Better World Books page exposes the full numbered table of contents through Ingram Syndetics, while Google Books confirms the same part structure and 2023 publication family.
No competing translation or materially different chapter order surfaced in source discovery, so no user question is required under the edition-selection rules.
